title: Nick Bosa: I don't think I've played my best football

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nick Bosa: I don't think I've played my best football
sources.description: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa's only stats in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys were one quarterback hit, four pressures and three penalties in 34 snaps.
